metadataRaw.title: How to Instantly Relieve Tailbone Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows effective exercises to help instantly relieve tailbone pain — even in as little as 30 seconds!

One of the main causes of tailbone (coccyx) pain is tightness or weakness in the muscles that support this area — especially the glutes and piriformis.

In this video, we’ll go over simple exercises that help stretch and strengthen these key muscles for fast and long-lasting tailbone pain relief.

Each exercise works a bit differently, so for the best results, try them all and stick with the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and start fixing your tailbone pain at home — fast!
